title: Matryoshka MMI — a constitutional memory organ (MCP server) for coding agents
description: A local MCP memory server: gives a coding agent its own plastic memory. The model is the only semantic subject — it decides what to remember and what to recall; the server only executes acts (TICK/WRITE/READ/STATUS) over an append-only bi-temporal journal (event time + record time). No scoring, no relevance rankers, no semantic search, no telemetry. Python stdlib only.
